notes: City of McKinney, TX (Collin County), within city limits. Built by data/jurisidictions/run_mckinney.py (collin_county.py, shared runner tx_multicounty.py). 66,161 parcels, $13.14B land. All values 2026.

Collin County: Collin Central Appraisal District's own public parcel layer (CCAD Parcel Feature Set, data of 2026-10-23); the layer has rolled to the 2027 roll year, so the 2026 certified values are its prior-year fields. Properties split for 2027 are re-joined with their child polygons, so each 2026 value sits on the land it was appraised for. McKinney: 18 parents re-joined with 22 child polygons ($91M land; e.g. Westridge Retail Lot 4 kept 0.12 ac and its whole 2026 value while new Lot 4-1 took 4.09 ac).
Check: Collin CAD's taxable land on City of McKinney properties (CMC) is $13.184B vs $13.138B kept.
City limits: Census TIGER/Line 2025 place 4845744; CCAD's McKinney code agrees on all but 8 / 29 accounts.

Exempt land dropped: CCAD's total exemption codes (EX-*, CHODO) plus named public owners: 749 records. Condos: 1,649 units in 68 developments merged onto their land; 1,823 leftover nominal common areas (1,652 ac) dropped like exempt land.
Singularity sweep: only hidden slivers and one vacant strip (Millwood Homes lots 35-1 / 36-1: 160-420 sqft carrying lot-size values) remain; nothing unresolved.
Under 100k parcels: browser GeoParquet path, no PMTiles bake.

Parking is OSM delivered through Overture Maps (release 2026-10-21.0, --overture-only), classified surface vs structure: 316 lots, 283.7 acres, $126M est. land value. apply_parking_category.py tagged 4 parcels 'Parking Lot'.
